description: This Java interface defines configuration settings related to signal enrichment in a gateway service. It provides methods to retrieve cache timeout durations, caching enablement flags, cache configuration objects, and to render the configuration as a Typesafe Config object. It also defines an enumeration for known configuration values like caching enablement and timeout durations.

classes.name: GatewaySignalEnrichmentConfig
classes.description: Interface representing configuration options for signal enrichment, including cache settings and timeout durations.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait for cache retrievals.

methods.name: isCachingEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether cache-based signal enrichment is enabled.

methods.name: getCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration to be used for each connection-scoped signal enrichment cache.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Produces a Typesafe Config object representing the current configuration settings.

inner_classes.name: CachingSignalEnrichmentFacadeConfigValue
inner_classes.description: Enum listing known configuration path expressions and their default values for signal enrichment cache settings.

constants.name: CACHING_ENABLED
constants.description: Indicates whether caching is enabled, default is true.

constants.name: ASK_TIMEOUT
constants.description: Timeout duration for cache retrievals, default is 10 seconds.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait for cache retrievals.

methods.name: isCachingEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether cache-based signal enrichment is enabled.

methods.name: getCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration object for signal enrichment.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates a Config object representing the current configuration.
